semiconductor_relevance: High — The company provides advanced ball placement solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Guangdong D-TEK Intelligent Equipment Co.,LTD. specializes in advanced ball placement solutions for semiconductor manufacturing, SMT, LED, LCD, and PCB industries. With over 10,000 units delivered, they are a key player in providing equipment that supports various stages of semiconductor production.
